note: Ball-handler by hand, judged without seeing any model's guess. verdict: 'box' (that box has it), 'missing' (somebody has it and no box was drawn for him -- his position is handler_at, and it is a player-detector miss), 'nobody' (in flight, loose, dead), 'unknown' (excluded from both sides of the score). pick is 'disagree' (the handler class and the nearest-to-ball rule chose different players here) or 'random'. boxes are the detector's, in the order shown.
